claims.detail: WHAT EACH COMPOSITES OVER. (1) gridline rgba(0,0,0,0.18): over the opaque ground only (normal: cell colours; prob: #ffffff base + BW cells). lineWidth 0.5 centred on a pixel centre covers half a pixel column, so effective per-pixel alpha is ~0.09, not 0.18 (reasoning about rasterisation, not browser-measured). The i=W line sits at 560.5 = off-canvas. (2) depot fill rgba(119,0,153,0.22): over ground + gridlines inside each 56x56 px block. (3) trails, fixed alpha (the 'fades' comment at sd:849 is not implemented as an alpha ramp; the trail is just capped at 60 points): over ground, gridlines, depot fill, the opaque #770099 stroke and 'BASE' text, and the opaque #000/#fff FOV + flee lines. One stroke() per unit, so trails of DIFFERENT units stack (1-(1-a)^n). Because history appends only on movement, a docked/stationary unit keeps its last <=60 points, so trails converge on depot berths and persist there. Example composites inside the depot: uav trail over fill-over-veg9 = #46696a, ff trail = #1f8b63; over fill-over-smoke #9490c1 / #68b0b4; over fill-over-burnt #4e4a7c / #276f73. (4) assignment line 0.8 (dashed 5,4, 1.8px) and dot 0.9 (r = 0.28*cs = 3.14px): over all of the above incl. trails; the firefighter square (drawn after, sd:859) covers the line's start and the victim circle (r 5.6px, sd:860) covers the dot when the victim is on the target cell. Off-canvas alpha, NOT part of the map: box-shadow rgba(0,0,0,.4) (sd:545); badge alphas via 8-digit hex '${c}22'/'${c}55' (sd:620); '#2f3b4733' td border (sd:543). Anti-aliasing adds further intermediate values at marker edges (UAV inset 1.12px, FF inset 1.68px at cs=11.2) and on the 0.5px '#000' UAV stroke (sd:862).
